regime_context: This is a narrow, two-name tape: Banks (crowded, elevated breadth) barely leads Innovative Pharma & CXO (also crowded) with a margin of 0.01, while only 4 of 22 themes pass the trend gate and rotation is non-directional. The only validated edge — the absolute-trend gate — did NOT hold on this market's history, so I lean low and treat even the clearest conditional as judgement, not extraction.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Innovative Pharma & CXO (159992.SZ) pulls decisively ahead of Banks (512800.SS) on a 10-day rolling relative return basis — I would retire this watch if Banks re-extends its lead back above a 3% relative gap, or if the margin stays under 1% for two consecutive weeks without a clean handoff.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks sit at the top of the eligibility gate with the highest durability_bar (0.73) and broad participation (breadth 0.889), suggesting resilient — if crowded — leadership. Its edge over Pharma is razor-thin, so this is a conditional lean on the existing leader continuing to consolidate rather than break down.
evidence: breadth 0.889 (broad participation, not a one-name story)
hurst_tag mixed (no clean trend, hence low conviction)
theses.dissent: The leader is crowded with a mixed Hurst tag, and the trend gate is unvalidated on this mean-reverting market — Banks could simply be late-stage attention with weak absolute trend health and the score is not a return forecast.
